meta.title: HSK 3.0 Level 2 — Chinese to English
meta.subtitle: 197 words · recall the meaning and pinyin
meta.desc: Shown the characters, recall the English meanings and the pinyin. The HSK 3.0 Level 2 vocabulary as the standard now stands — the word list announced at the end of 2025 and in force from 2026, not the 2021 list it replaced, which is a different and much longer one (500 words at Level 1 against 300). Every card carries the simplified form, the traditional form, pinyin, bopomofo, the measure word where the word takes one, and the full range of English translations rather than a single gloss. Traditional characters are shown at half strength, and are omitted entirely where they are identical to the simplified — 91 of the 197 words. The standard asks for 500 words by the end of this level and the three decks add up to 491, so a handful are missing: the published figures are round numbers rather than a count of rows, and no openly readable copy of the new list settles which words make up the difference. Word list: the 2025 revision of the HSK 3.0 syllabus. Definitions, readings and measure words: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0).
